about: The Disk Speed Test's tests: Veeam's own DiskSpd and fio tests from KB2014, one per Veeam operation, and a custom test for the DiskSpd wizard on the Integrations page. SAT builds the command from these fields and never from typed text. 'write_percent' above 0 always targets SAT's own new test file; 'reads_backup_file' tests, and a custom test pointed at an existing file, open it for reading only. 'divide_by' is the KB's reading of a random test: the I/Os each block costs.

source.title: KB2014: How to Simulate Veeam Backup & Replication Disk I/O

defaults.block_size_note: 512 KB matches the default storage optimization (1 MB blocks, compressed to about half). 256 KB matches LAN target, 128 KB WAN target, 2 MB Local target (large blocks).

custom.about: Any share of writes, sequential or random, with the threads, outstanding I/Os, warm-up and caching chosen. '-c{size}' is only ever passed when SAT creates its own file. A preset that names a 'role' ('Backup repository', 'Backup source') sets the wizard's Used as choice and follows KB2014's tests in the list; one that names none is a quick look and leaves the choice as it is.

presets.name: Quick look: one minute of sequential writes
presets.description: A minute of writing in large blocks to SAT's own 4 GB file: a fast first reading of how quickly this storage takes data written in order. KB2014's tests run longer to get past the storage's cache.

presets.name: Quick look: one minute of sequential reads
presets.description: A minute of reading in large blocks: SAT's own 4 GB file in a folder, or a file you choose, which SAT only reads. A fast first reading of how quickly data comes off this storage.

presets.name: Quick look: one minute of mixed random reads and writes
presets.description: A minute of random reads and writes, half each, in 64 KB blocks with a deeper queue: a fast first reading of how the storage copes with busy, scattered work, such as a merge on a repository or a database on a source.

presets.name: Source: full backup (sequential read)
presets.description: Reads the source in order, 1 MB at a time, as a full backup does, for 5 minutes. Choose a large file there, which SAT only reads, or a folder, where SAT reads its own 4 GB test file and deletes it. It reads as hard as a backup does, so run it outside busy hours.

presets.name: Source: incremental backup (random read)
presets.description: Reads the source scattered, 1 MB at a time, as an incremental backup reads the blocks that changed, for 5 minutes. Choose a large file there, which SAT only reads, or a folder, where SAT reads its own 4 GB test file and deletes it.

presets.name: Source: restore (sequential write)
presets.description: Writes SAT's own 4 GB test file in order, 1 MB at a time, as a full restore writes the data back, for 5 minutes, then deletes it. Choose a folder on the source's storage.

tests.name: Sequential write
tests.preset: Repository: active full or incremental backup (sequential write)
tests.simulates: Active full and forward incremental backups

tests.name: Random, half write
tests.preset: Repository: synthetic full or merge (random, half writes)
tests.simulates: Synthetic full backups and forever forward incremental merges

tests.name: Random read of a backup file
tests.preset: Repository: restore, slowest case (random read of a backup file)
tests.simulates: Restore, health check and SureBackup of a fragmented backup file: the low end of restore speed

tests.name: Sequential read of a backup file
tests.preset: Repository: restore, fastest case (sequential read of a backup file)
tests.simulates: Restore of an unfragmented backup file: the high end of restore speed
